balanced_sorter_free_voltage_pilot.design: one deterministic event from every probe/window/depth-third/polarity/amplitude cell; 648 sealed events retained for confirmation

official_nonrigid_p2_extrapolate_int16.decision: do_not_sort_yet; inspect tail and require a rigid benchmark

single_pass_shared_window_sort.interpretation: No clear dominance: the conservative rigid branch preserves recovery and modestly improves contamination/coincidence, but loses seven KS-good units and slightly worsens refractory violations.

full_rigid_pathological_double_preproces.warning: This legacy current-conditioned source receives another Kilosort preprocessing pass and is not production-valid after the single-pass baseline was selected.
full_rigid_pathological_double_preproces.decision: reject_full_rigid; use only as supporting diagnostic

confirmatory_depth_strip.failure: edge spike fraction doubled from 0.0998 to 0.2011
confirmatory_depth_strip.interior_80um: recovery unchanged; contamination, coincidence excess and refractory violations worsened
confirmatory_depth_strip.scope_guardrail: This rejects resampling an already cropped strip, not voltage resampling with real-voltage boundary support.

supported_inward_crop.rigid_costs: 10 fewer units, one fewer KS-good unit, contamination 16.7 to 23.25 percent, refractory violations 0.00702 to 0.01130, and median first-last PC cosine 0.954 to 0.928
supported_inward_crop.rigid_benefits: slightly lower coincidence excess and depth excursion, with fewer duplicate-pair screens

next_gate: Retain no motion. Do not promote rigid-0.25 to a full-probe KS4 sort. Continue sorter-free artifact/residual validation and consider a different motion scale or motion-aware sorter only under a separately prespecified test.
